details: Bitcoin dropped below $65,000 following the Trump administration's announcement of new global tariffs, ranging from 10% to 12.5% on imports from 60 countries, primarily due to forced labor concerns. This move has added pressure to the crypto market amid geopolitical tensions.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $65K Amid New US Global Tariffs

details: Democrats have rejected the latest draft of the CLARITY Act, citing concerns over ethics and illicit finance. This ongoing dispute highlights the challenges in establishing clear crypto regulations in the US.
title: Democrats Reject CLARITY Act Draft Over Ethics & Illicit Finance Concerns

details: In what's been dubbed "Hackers Day," three separate crypto protocols were reportedly drained of a combined $35 million within a 24-hour period. This underscores persistent security vulnerabilities in the decentralized finance (DeFi) space.
title: Three Crypto Protocols Lose $35M in Hacks Within 24 Hours

details: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has agreed to overhaul its recordkeeping practices as part of a settlement in a lawsuit filed by Coinbase, which alleged that SEC Chair Gary Gensler's text messages were lost.
title: SEC Agrees to Overhaul Recordkeeping Post-Coinbase Lawsuit Settlement

details: Ripple has introduced its new "Ripple Mint" platform, designed to simplify institutional access to its regulated RLUSD stablecoin. The platform provides tools for minting, redeeming, and managing RLUSD via web or API for both manual and automated workflows.
title: Ripple Launches 'Ripple Mint' to Enhance Institutional RLUSD Access

details: S&P Dow Jones Indices has partnered with Pantera Capital to launch a new crypto index. The index includes major cryptocurrencies such as Ether, Solana, BNB, and HYPE, signaling growing institutional interest in diversified crypto exposure.
title: S&P and Pantera Capital Launch New Crypto Index

details: Movement Labs, a crypto project that recently raised $141 million, has filed for bankruptcy, with its daily fees reportedly plummeting to just $8. This highlights the volatile nature and business risks within the crypto startup landscape.
title: Movement Labs Files for Bankruptcy After $141M Fundraise
